description:
Perform a ratiometric analysis on the 'Fluorescent Cells' sample image. 

1. Open the 'Fluorescent Cells' sample (File > Open Samples).
2. Generate a 32-bit floating-point ratio image where each pixel value = Red_Channel / Green_Channel.
3. The ratio should ONLY be calculated for the cell area (defined by the Green channel). Pixels outside the cells (background) must be set to 0 or NaN.
4. Save the resulting ratio image as a 32-bit TIFF to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/ratio_map.tif'.
5. Measure the Mean intensity of this ratio image (within the cell mask) and save the value to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/mean_ratio.txt'.

Note: Ensure you convert images to 32-bit float before dividing to preserve precision.
